source.note: Maps 38 seal-script characters from the Daozong and Xuanyi covers to Unicode. The Xuanyi blocks were matched by shape.

XY-01.basis: Shape matches the seal-script glyph for this code point in BabelStone Khitan Small Seal; the sixteen blocks follow the cover title read by Shimunek 2017.
